## Biography
I am a Lecturer (Teaching and Leadership) in the School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences at Macquarie University, with a 70% teaching and 30% leadership role. 

My research interests include variable selection, stability selection, complex modelling, and statistical graphics.

## Education
- **Graduate Certificate in Education**, Macquarie University (2023–2024)
- **Doctor of Philosophy in Statistics**, University of Sydney (2017–2022)
  - Supervisors: Professor Samuel Muller and Dr Boris Guennewig
- **Bachelor of Science (Adv.) (Honours Class I)**, University of Sydney (2013–2016)
  - Supervisor: Professor Samuel Muller
